assign.outcome:
**Two of three realms fixed; the third measured and deliberately not shipped.** `/imagine/generated/` and `/imagine/cms/` now use `width: "large"` (the doc's own word for a grid/table/wide-content column) instead of `fill` — a topic-drill test on both `/imagine/research/` and `/imagine/generated/seed-7/` showed `fill`'s `flex: 1 1 100%` squeezes any column opened beneath it to its 288px floor and overflows the row, matching the coordinator's flag on `/imagine/platform/research/cloudflare/verdict/` exactly. CMS also gets a genuine third region: the page's own closing paragraph (Thinking/Services/JSON/readme links, moved verbatim) is now an inline `classes: "default"` child `Guide`, opened by core with no `columns()` call needed on CMS itself. `/imagine/research/` is git-identical to HEAD — `fill` was measured, found to break topic-drilling, and reverted; the trade-off is in the log for the mastermind's columns-rule proposal (a `fill` column should yield to an open child).

At 3440: generated 36.6%/2180px dead -> 46%/1856px dead; cms 36.6%/2180px dead -> 70.1%/1028px dead (79.5%/704px dead with a child open beside it, no squeeze); research unchanged at 46%/1856px dead (front alone) but reaches 100%/0px dead with `fill` -- at the cost of squeezing an open topic to 288px, which is why it wasn't shipped. All three invariants (no text/box at x:0, no prose past the measure, no hand-typed spacing constant) hold before and after at 1280 and 3440; zero new console errors (one pre-existing, harmless `cms/welcome/page.js` 404 is the framework's own lazy-load probe, unchanged by this task).

**Left undone:** research's dead-space fix, pending the columns-rule change (fill yields to an open child) the mastermind is proposing to the owner.
